[[File:Poll booth icon.png|left]]
A '''poll booth''' is a piece of interactive scenery found in various locations around [[Gielinor]], usually near [[bank]]s. By interacting with it, you gain access to an interface allowing you to vote in [[polls]].

Each poll will usually run for a duration of one week. To participate, you'll need to be a member with a total skill level of at least 300 and a minimum total play-time of 25 hours in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]''. Each poll can contain multiple questions which detail potential changes or content in-game. A question requires a 70% {{wp|supermajority}} of ''Yes'' votes to pass, excluding ''Skip question ''votes.

While a poll is running the flag on every poll booth will be raised, except for the poll booth on [[Mount Karuulm]] where the eyes of the skull light up instead.

[[File:Poll booth.gif|thumb|left|200px|The Poll booth animation.]]

{{Subject changes

|update = Bounty Hunter Returns
|change = The poll booth in Prifddinas bank has been removed because it was causing an obstruction.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 26 March 2020
|update = Game Improvements (26 March 2020)
|poll =
|change = The poll booth within the [[Motherlode Mine]] has been removed.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 30 May 2019
|update = Poll 67 Updates and Hosidius Improvements
|change = The poll booth has been moved slightly further from the deposit box in the Motherlode Mine bank area.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 9 August 2018
|update = Looting Bag Improvements, PID Changes and Bounty Hunter Targets
|change = The poll booth located outside the front of the volcanic mine has been removed as players would be hit with volcanic debris while trying to vote in polls. There are already other poll booths available on the Island.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 16 July 2015
|update = Duel Arena Rework
|change = The poll booth history display has been rewritten to accommodate more polls without crashing. This feature will be made accessible once further testing has taken place on the live game worlds.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 10 December 2014
|update = The Trading Post
|change = The poll booths in Seers Village and in Ardougne south bank have been returned.
}}
{{Subject changes footer}}

==Trivia==
*In 2014, an inaccessible poll booth could be seen near the pen north of the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]]. If players were somehow able to access it, a message appeared saying ''"It's just here for testing. Please leave it alone."''
*While the majority of poll booths will let the player open the voting interface without any prerequisites, there are some that will not:
**The poll booth in the Bandit Camp forbids the player from voting if they are wearing any items affiliated with [[Zamorak]] or [[Saradomin]], giving the message ''"The bandits don't like your attire, and will not take kindly to you using their poll booth."''
**The poll booth in Darkmeyer forbids the player from voting if they are not wearing [[vyre noble clothing]]; the nearby banker will shout ''"Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!"''
***This poll booth is usable regardless of attire after completion of [[The Blood Moon Rises]].
**The poll booth in [[Rellekka]] forbids the player from voting is they have not completed [[The Fremennik Trials]] and became a [[Fremennik]].
* The poll booth in Kourend Castle is the only poll booth that does not raise its flag when there is an active poll running.
